Title: E. 24-25 School Year Calendar/Snow Day

fields.Content:
At this point in the 2024-2025 school year, we have missed 11 days of school due to inclement weather. Six of those days were designated as AMI days (1/6, 1/7, 1/8, 1/9, 1/10, and 2/19), which means that we will need to make up 5 school days (1/21, 2/5, 2/12, 2/13, and 2/20). The Cabinet and Director Team recommends the following 5 make-up dates:
  • March 13th (Thursday) - Previously designated as a non-school day for Parent-Teacher Conferences. We are proposing to have school on this date. Please note, however, that Parent-Teacher Conferences will still take place on two evenings that week (8 hours total, as noted above) and there will be No School on Friday, March 14th.
  • April 25th (Friday) - Previously designated as a non-school day for Staff Professional Development. We are proposing to have school on this date.
  • May 27th-May 29th (Tuesday-Thursday) - Previously, May 23rd was designated as the last day of school. We will now need to have students and staff return after the Memorial Day holiday. We are proposing to have school on these dates.
Meagan Patterson, Assistant Superintendent of Student Support and Success
